node.title: Re: url get with string
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If $name is just a simple string like you showed, with no special characters, then [huck] has given you [id://1185571|the answer] in regards to interpolation in '$name' vs. "$name".

However, if you've got any special characters in that string, they need to be escaped properly. Here's one way with [mod://URI]:

use URI; my $name = 'xyz&foo=bar'; my $uri = URI->new('https://www.google.com/'); $uri->query_form( name => $name, foo => 'quz', ); print "$uri\n"; __END__ https://www.google.com/?name=xyz%26foo%3Dbar&foo=quz
